info.title: ETEL Delivery & Ride API
info.description: Every action is a JSON POST to /api/boot.php with an `action` field (a few read-only actions also accept GET query parameters). Responses are JSON: {success: true|false, data: {...}, message: '...', v: '<app version>'}. Send the session token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; get one from `login`, `etelid_login` (Delivery/Ride apps) or `admin_etelid_login` (admin). Admin accounts with two-step sign-in answer {requires_2fa: true}: repeat the same login request with `totp_code`. Errors use HTTP 400/401/403/404/409/429/500/503 with the same JSON shape. Throttled actions answer 429. This file is generated from the source by tools/gen_api_docs.py: 419 actions. Parameter names come from the handlers; types and limits are in the handler code.
